name: 5370-batchdecode-dsv2litefp8-1gpu
parallelism: tp1. One GPU of an 8-GPU node; no tensor, pipeline, data or expert parallelism, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over /v1/completions, single turn, no shared prefix. Each request is ~1024 prompt tokens (stdev 128, clamped 768-1280) generating ~512 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 384-640), seed 42.
purpose: A code-completion assistant serving 64 concurrent developers thousand-token prompts and long completions on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit e9fc2ac7b6115bf3a690ccc4b6f52bb77d5c7b7a
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.4.5-113-ge9fc2ac7b61).

model-path: RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: fa3

# The checkpoint advertises 163840 positions via YaRN, and that number is not free: at it,
# `init_memory_pool` allocates ReqToTokenPool as a ~1.3 TB int32 device tensor and the server
# never starts. The longest request this workload can produce is 1280 + 640 = 1920 tokens.
context-length: 8192

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
